overview.description: The Goldman Sachs Income ETF (GINC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fixed income ETF aiming to provide a high level of current income with a secondary focus on capital appreciation. The ETF uses fundamental research to invests across a multi-sector portfolio of global investment grade and non-investment grade fixed income securities, with a target average duration of 08 years. GINC was launched on Aug 7, 2026 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.
